craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Hetu fenced; Buddhist mark refused per prose scope. Rejected: (a) variety→difference → killed: variety is the fenced term. Read aloud: SO the-CAUSE … NOR as PAR-tic-u-lar's-MARK.

lines: So the cause: bare locus-form, here set apart —
not by mere variety, nor as particular's mark.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ ca hetuḥ saṃsthānamātramatra viśeṣitam tathā vaicitryamātreṇa na svalakṣaṇalakṣmaṇā

reads_against.argmap: What is the hetu, and what is excluded? → The hetu stated (locus-form alone) and fenced: not bare variety as particular-mark.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
